text: Dogs must stay in authorized places at all times; only about 20% of trails and campsites are open to them.
Dogs must be leashed and supervised at all times; dogs 20 kg and over need a head halter or harness.
Pick up waste immediately; barking, howling or aggressive dogs are not tolerated.
Dogs must sleep in the same camping unit as their owner and never be left alone in it.
No dogs inside buildings, including cabins, rustic camps and ready-to-camp units.
Only dogs are allowed; other pets are banned in Québec national parks.
Guide and assistance dogs with visible ID are allowed everywhere visitors go; emotional support dogs follow the normal dog rules.
